title: Pete Capitán — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word 105bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Dad saved his number under Pete Capitán
Not the first name, not the surname — just the man
What's in a name? Everything, Chas would say
The Captain's always there at the start of the day

[Verse 2 — Español]
Hijo mayor por siete años y contando [Oldest son by seven years and counting]
Primero en la mesa, primero levantado [First to the table, first up in the morning]
Rugby en la sangre y aire salado en el pecho [Rugby in his blood and salt air in his chest]
Chas lo puso en el teléfono — y eso dijo el resto [Chas put it in the phone — and that said all the rest]

[Chorus — English]
Pete Capitán, first over the line
Pete Capitán, been leading since nine
Rooftop to the ocean, hammer to the helm
Pete Capitán — it's always been your realm

[Bridge — Français]
Corey est au milieu, Joel ferme la marche [Corey's in the middle, Joel brings up the rear]
Mais ils savent tous les deux qui a donné le ton [But they both know who set the tone]
On ne gagne pas le titre de Capitán de son père en restant immobile [You don't earn Capitán from your dad by sitting still]
On le gagne sur le toit, on le gagne sur la houle [You earn it on the rooftop, you earn it on the swell]

[Verse 3 — English]
Live wire never quits, oldest never stops
Pete Capitán — from the rooftop to the docks

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
Pete Capitán
Pete Capitán
That's my boy
Ese es mi chico [That's my boy]
C'est mon fils [That's my boy]
